content: लता [लत्-अच्] .²1 A creeper, creeping plant; लताभावेन परिणतमस्या रूपम् <ls>V. 4</ls>; लतेव संनद्धमनोज्ञपल्लवा <ls>R. 3. 7</ls> (often used as the last member of compounds, especially with words meaning ‘arm’, ‘eyebrow’, ‘lightning’, to denote beauty, tenderness, thinness <ab>&c.</ab>; भुजलता, बाहुलता, भ्रूलता, विद्युल्लता); so खड्ग˚, अलक˚, <ab>&c.</ab>; <ab>cf.</ab> <ls>Ku. 2. 64</ls>; <ls>Me. 49</ls>; <ls>Ś. 3. 14</ls>; <ls>R. 9. 46</ls>. .²2 A branch; मधुसुरभिणि षट्पदेन पुष्पे मुख इव शाललतावधूश्चुचुम्बे <ls>Ki. 10. 34</ls>; <ls>Rām. 2. 80. 6</ls>. .²3 The creeper called {%Priyaṅgu%}. .²4 The Mādhavī creeper. .²5 Musk-creeper. .²6 A whip or the lash of a whip. .²7 A string of pearls. .²8 A slender woman. .²9 A woman in general. .²10 The Dūrvā grass.
